## PDF page 571

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/grinders%20manual.pdf#page=571)

```text
           1: vs. UTG-HJ 3x

I wasn't kidding when I said that we'd
have to be tighter from this seat. Many of
the hands that we called from the BB are
now going to drop considerably in EV
due to the aforementioned two pitfalls of
the SB. Hero now flats a snug and
powerful range that has great implied
odds (88) or is in very fine shape (AQo)
or both (JJ).
```
